chapter_title_en: The Burden of a Dao Heart
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch.493 – Tonghe Immortal Unleashes the Extermination Sword Against a 18-Immortal Siege
chapter_meta_description: The Seamless Gate surrounds Anchan City with 18 veteran Celestial Immortals. The Tonghe Immortal unveils a never-before-seen trump card, the Extermination Immortal Sword, shocking even his enemies.
og_title: An Unforeseen Storm Gathers: Desolate Era Ch.493
og_description: Eighteen immortals lay siege, but one ancient swordsman has been waiting. The Tonghe Immortal’s hidden technique is revealed, and a legend is reborn in battle.
twitter_title: The Sword Awakens: Desolate Era Ch.493
twitter_description: The Seamless Gate's 18 Celestial Immortals try to trap the Tonghe Immortal. He responds with the legendary 'Extermination Immortal Sword.' This chapter is pure Xianxia fire.

lore_anchors.definition: In Chinese mythology, Bixia is one of the nine sons of the Dragon King, depicted as a giant turtle carrying a stone stele on its back. In Desolate Era, the Bixia Formation is an ancient defensive battle array, named for this creature, renowned for its ability to absorb and neutralize attacks.

A direct reference to one of the four legendary swords from the novel 'Fengshen Yanyi.' It is a supremely powerful killing weapon. The Tonghe Immortal's use of this technique signals a hidden power level far beyond a normal Celestial Immortal.

A stage above a standard True Immortal. An existence at this level has fully integrated the Yang principle into their spiritual foundation, achieving a qualitative leap in power and immortality that sets them apart as nearly undying war gods among the immortals.

A technique where a cultivator projects their consciousness as a silent, undetectable wave to monitor a vast area. It is demanding to maintain for long periods but is virtually impossible to evade, making it the gold standard for surveillance in Xianxia.

The classic symbol of Yin and Yang from Daoist philosophy. In the novel, the Tonghe Immortal’s sword technique manifests these principles as two clouds chasing each other, representing the ultimate balance of two fundamental forces being channeled into a single, world-shaking attack.

cultural_notes_faq.a: A defensive battle array created by 18 Celestial Immortals of the Seamless Gate. It forms a massive, turtle-like projection (a son of the dragon) that excels at absorbing attacks and protecting its users.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does the Tonghe Immortal refuse Ji Ning's help?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He believes the Seamless Gate's forces are specifically calibrated to kill him, and dragging the Black-White College immortals into the fight would likely get them killed. His pride and sense of responsibility compel him to face this alone.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Extermination Immortal Sword?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It's a legendary, hidden sword technique from the primordial era. The Tonghe Immortal reveals it for the first time in this battle, fusing six flying swords into one colossal blade to create an overwhelming attack.
